en.title: One chord. More ways to play it.
en.intro: Find guitar voicings, hear their notes, and connect familiar CAGED shapes across the fretboard.
en.hero_alt: Real Frankie Guitar interface with C major selected, chord variations on the left and its wood fretboard on the right.
en.hero_caption: The actual app: C major, standard tuning, no capo.
en.features_title: From a chord name to your fretboard
features: Select a root and a chord quality, from major and minor to seventh, suspended and extended chords. The formula explains which intervals make the chord.
A voicing is one arrangement of a chord’s notes. Browse positions, read the six-string fret notation and hear a synthetic strum or individual notes.
Choose a tuning preset and capo position, mirror the fretboard for left-handed playing, and choose sharp or flat note names.
See the notes around the shape
Add a scale reference, reveal the full chord-tone map, or switch note names to intervals. Explore how a selected chord sits inside the surrounding fretboard.
en.caged_title: CAGED: five shapes, one connected neck
en.caged_intro: CAGED is named after the open C, A, G, E and D major chord shapes. Moving these forms along a standard-tuned guitar gives different positions for a chord. The shape name describes the fingering pattern, not necessarily the chord you hear.
en.caged_example: For example, these five views all play C major: C, E and G. An A-shaped C chord is still C major. Choose a shape below to inspect its real app view and compare where the roots fall.
en.shape_label: Choose a recorded C major shape
en.shape_alt: Recorded Frankie Guitar C major voicing; use the C A G E D buttons to compare shape positions.
en.demo_note: These are screenshots of the real app, not a live fretboard. Read the fret numbers from low E to high E; x means a muted string and 0 means an open string. Open the app to hear and change the voicings.
en.theory_source: Further reading on the five movable chord forms:
en.caged_limit: In this app, a letter badge appears only when a generated voicing exactly matches a major CAGED pattern. Recognition requires standard tuning intervals (including uniformly lowered tunings). Alternate tunings and other chord qualities can still generate voicings without a CAGED badge.
steps: Keep Standard tuning and no capo. The formula 1–3–5 corresponds to C–E–G. Choose the first x 3 2 0 1 0 voicing.
Keep the chord, move the shape
Choose the A badge (x 3 5 5 5 3), then the E badge (8 10 10 9 8 8). The notes stay within C major while the register and arrangement change.
Press Play Chord for a synthetic strum. Tap a note on the board to hear it individually. Compare the root locations instead of memorizing only the outline.
Open Setup. Try Major (Ionian) under Scale Reference, then Full Chord Map and Interval Labels. Change tuning or capo only when it matches the guitar you are using.
gallery: Setup: C major scale reference, full chord-tone map and interval labels, shown together.
Instrument setup: tuning, capo, spelling, scale and left-handed orientation.
en.runtime_title: Use it online, or run it locally
en.runtime: The chord search and audio synthesis run in the browser. The online app opens directly. For local use, install Node.js, then run these commands in the repository:
limits: This is a chord explorer, not a microphone tuner or a course with scored exercises. Playback is synthesized audio, not a guitar recording.
The generator uses a bounded search and fret-span/finger-count heuristics. Results are useful candidates, not every possible fingering or a guarantee of physical comfort.
The capo shifts the effective tuning; chord names refer to sounding pitch. The app shows absolute physical fret positions on the board.
Changing or reloading the app resets the current controls; there is no saved practice library.
en.guide_title: Keep the introduction in step with the app
en.guide: The maintenance guide maps each screenshot and explanation to its source screen or code. Refresh those assets when controls, fretboard rendering or chord behavior changes.

zh.title: 同一个和弦，更多种弹法。
zh.intro: 寻找吉他和弦指型、聆听音符，用熟悉的 CAGED 形状连接整块指板。
zh.category: 交互式吉他和弦查找器
zh.hero_alt: 真实 Frankie Guitar 界面：左侧为 C 大三和弦指型列表，右侧为木质指板。
zh.hero_caption: 真实应用：C 大三和弦、标准调弦、无变调夹。
zh.features_title: 把和弦名称变成指板上的位置
features: 选择根音和和弦类型，包括大三、小三、七和弦、挂留与延伸和弦。和弦公式说明组成它的音程。
指型对应和弦音的一种排列。浏览不同把位、读取六弦品位记法，聆听合成扫弦或单个音符。
选择调弦预设与变调夹位置，切换左手指板方向，并按需要显示升号或降号。
叠加音阶参考，显示全部和弦音位置，或把音名换成音程。查看所选和弦与周围指板的关系。
zh.caged_title: CAGED：五个形状，连起整块指板
zh.caged_intro: CAGED 得名于开放把位的 C、A、G、E、D 五种大三和弦形状。在标准调弦下移动这些形状，可以在不同把位弹奏和弦。形状名称描述指法结构，不一定等于实际发声的和弦名称。
zh.caged_example: 例如，下方五个画面弹的都是 C 大三和弦，组成音都是 C、E、G。A 形状的 C 和弦仍然是 C 大三和弦。选择一个形状，查看应用真实界面，并比较根音位置。
zh.shape_label: 选择录制的 C 大三和弦形状
zh.shape_alt: 真实 Frankie Guitar C 大三和弦指型截图，可用 C A G E D 按钮比较把位。
zh.demo_note: 这些是真实应用截图，并非实时指板。品位数字从低音 E 弦读到高音 E 弦；x 表示不发声，0 表示空弦。打开应用即可试听和切换指型。
zh.theory_source: 关于五种可移动和弦形状的延伸阅读：
zh.caged_limit: 应用只会给严格匹配大三和弦 CAGED 模式的指型显示字母标记。识别要求标准调弦的弦间音程（整体降调也适用）。其他调弦或和弦类型仍可生成指型，但不一定带有 CAGED 标记。
steps: 从 C 大三和弦开始
保留 Standard 调弦，不使用变调夹。公式 1–3–5 对应 C–E–G。先选择 x 3 2 0 1 0 指型。
选择 A 标记的 x 3 5 5 5 3，再选择 E 标记的 8 10 10 9 8 8。音符仍属于 C 大三和弦，但音区和排列发生变化。
点击 Play Chord 试听合成扫弦，点击指板音符单独发声。比较根音在哪里，而不只记住形状轮廓。
打开 Setup，选择 Major (Ionian) 音阶参考，再启用 Full Chord Map 和 Interval Labels。调弦和变调夹位置应与实际乐器相符。
gallery: 设置界面：同时显示 C 大调音阶参考、全部和弦音与音程标签。
乐器设置：调弦、变调夹、音名拼写、音阶与左手方向。
zh.runtime_title: 在线使用，也可以本地运行
zh.runtime: 和弦搜索与声音合成都在浏览器运行。在线应用可直接打开。本地使用先安装 Node.js，再在仓库目录执行：
limits: 这是和弦探索工具，不是通过麦克风识音的调音器，也不是带评分练习的课程。播放为合成音，不是吉他录音。
生成器使用有限搜索、品位跨度与手指数等启发式规则。结果是参考指型，并不覆盖所有弹法，也不保证每个指型都适合你的手。
变调夹会改变有效调弦，和弦名称表示实际发声音高；指板显示实际物理品位。
刷新应用会重置当前控件，没有保存练习库。
zh.guide_title: 让介绍页跟上应用的变化
zh.guide: 维护指南把每张截图与说明对应到实际页面或代码。控件、指板渲染或和弦行为变化后，更新相应素材与说明。
